import re

# Extract reset code from already-fetched Gmail thread_detail
body = thread_detail['emails'][0]['body'] if isinstance(thread_detail, dict) else ''
print('body_sample', body[:200].replace('\n',' '))

m = re.search(r'password reset code is:\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)', body, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
if not m:
    # fallback: look for "code is" followed by token
    m = re.search(r'code is[:\s]*([A-Za-z0-9]+)', body, flags=re.IGNORECASE)

code = m.group(1) if m else None
print('extracted_reset_code', code)

new_password = 'aQAdQp'
email = 'anita.burch@gmail.com'

# Reset Venmo password
reset_resp = apis.venmo.reset_password(email=email, password_reset_code=code, new_password=new_password)
print('reset_resp', reset_resp)

# Verify by logging in with new password
login_resp = apis.venmo.login(username=email, password=new_password)
